title: We have no card for this — here is what helps in almost every emergency
applies_to: Anyone hurt or suddenly unwell when this app has no card for what you typed.

citations.source: WHO and IFRC International First Aid, Resuscitation and Education Guidelines 2020
citations.section: General approach to a person who is ill or injured

citations.source: European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2021: First Aid

steps.text: Look around first. Do not walk into water, fire, traffic, or a building that may fall.
Call for help now. Say where you are and say what you can see.
Ask them what happened. If they cannot answer you, watch whether they are breathing normally.
Keep them still and keep them warm. Do not move them unless staying there will hurt them.
Do not give them anything to eat or drink.
If they stop answering you and stop breathing normally, push hard on the middle of the chest and do not stop.
Stay with them. Keep telling them that help is coming.

do_not: Do not give them medicine of any kind.
Do not let a crowd move them or crowd in around them.
Do not put anything in their mouth.
escalate_if: They stop answering you, or their breathing changes — say that on the phone straight away.
The place you are in stops being safe — get yourself out first, then call again.
